job.description: Design Engineer 🚀 We’re Hiring NOW | Design Engineer (SolidWorks) | Funplay Systems Pvt. Ltd. If SolidWorks is your playground and you love turning ideas into real, buildable designs. We want to hear from you! 👇 At Funplay Systems Pvt. Ltd., we’re growing fast and looking for a Design Engineer who can bring concepts to life with precision and practicality. ⚡ What we’re looking for: Strong hands-on experience in SolidWorks Ability to create production-ready 2D/3D designs Understanding of fabrication, materials & structures A proactive, solution-driven mindset 🔥 What you’ll do: Design and develop play equipment & structures Create detailed drawings for manufacturing Work closely with cross-functional teams Solve real-world engineering challenges 💡 Why join us? Fast-paced, growth-driven environment High ownership and real impact Opportunity to see your designs come to life If you’re ready to build, innovate, and grow, this is your chance. 📩 Send your resume to: hr@funplaysystems.com #Hiring #DesignEngineer #SolidWorks #EngineeringJobs #HiringNow #Manufacturing #MechanicalDesign #CareerOpportunity
